title: Morning capture: interview scheduling + follow-ups
content:
Morning dump - quick plan + things to action (Jordan)

Date: 2026-03-15
Context: heavy interview day, 2 panels + take-home scoring due. Prioritize candidate experience and closing loops for offer pairs.

Today focus (top 3):
- 9:00–10:00 AM: Confirmers + reschedule any conflicts (high-touch candidates)
- 11:00–1:00 PM: Panel coordination for Backend Eng (Panel A) — ensure interviewers have prompts and rubric link
- 3:30–5:00 PM: Send follow-ups / next steps to onsite candidates and update GH status

Quick checklist (tick as done):
- [ ] Ping Panel A about rubrics (remind to add score comments)
- [ ] Reconfirm candidate timezones for EMEA candidate (Samir) — candidate email sent 2026-03-14, no reply
- [ ] Post-interview note templates ready (role-specific)
- [ ] Create calendar block for debriefs: 30m after each panel
- [ ] Check take-home submissions queue (assign to reviewers if >48h)

Candidate follow-ups / reminders (actionable):
- Priya K (SWE II) — had intro call 3/12. Hiring mgr asked to move to panel. ACTION: propose 2 slots Mon/Tue next week (include calendar options). Candidate prefers mornings PST. Use GH link: https://greenhouse.company.com/candidate/12987
- Samir A (Data Eng) — timezone mismatch note. If no reply by 10:30AM, call +1 (note to self: mobile in GH).
- Rafael B (PM) — reschedule interviewer due to emergency. Send apology + 3 new times; cc recruiter lead.
- Offer pipeline check: check finalist list for CompOps approval (req RI-101). If budget sign-off not in, flag to Luchi (comp) by EOD.

Interview admin notes (for panels):
- Panel A (Backend): Zoom links created (use interview.zoom/RI-backend-A), interview pack: Confluence playbook -> scoring rubric section. Send Slack reminder 30m prior to panel and include candidate resume PDF.
- Panel B (Infra): two interviewers running late historically — pre-assign backup (SRE on-call) and set fallback in calendar description.

Templates / quick copy snippets to use:
- Reschedule request (short): "Hi {candidate}, apologies — an interviewer had an emergency. Can we do {slot1}, {slot2}, or {slot3}? Appreciate your flexibility."
- Post-interview thank you: "Thanks for meeting with us today — panel feedback will be shared within 72 hours. If you have any immediate questions please reply here."

Notes to self / backlog items:
- Follow up with CompOps re: offer band for Senior PM candidates — pending docs (ticket CO-547)
- Draft updated interviewer cheat sheet with example questions for System Design (ask Eng L4 leads for 3 examples)
- Clean up GH pipeline columns: rename "phone screen" -> "initial screen" (small UX ask)

Unresolved / blockers:
- Hiring manager for Data Eng request for time compression: wants to shorten panels 15m — need Ops approval for rubric changes. Slack-thread: #hiring-ops (waiting response from Vikram).
- Candidate background check for EU hire (Lena) requires local vendor quote — who is POC? (people-ops security listed vendor in Confluence page)

End-of-day targets:
- All reschedule requests sent (unless await candidate reply)
- Panels have debriefs scheduled and notes template attached
- Move 3 candidates to "interviewed" status in GH with tags: feedback-pending

Random notes / brain dump:
- Consider batching calendar reminders into two sends (24h & 1h) to reduce interviewer no-shows
- Ask product recruiting lead for 1 pager on hiring rationale for BE role to include in candidate packet
- Quick win: add "expected commute/remote hours" field to GH to avoid timezone confusion

Triage log (timestamps):
- 08:50 AM: Found missing resume in Panel A packet -> uploaded to GH
- 09:12 AM: Reschedule accepted by Rafael B — new time 3/19 10:30 PT
- 09:45 AM: Left voicemail for Samir A (mobile found in GH)

If stuck: escalate to Maya (recruiting lead) or drop note in #recruiting-ops.

-- end of morning capture --

TODOs for later this week (brief):
- Prep batch outreach for campus candidates (April intern req)
- Update diversity slate process doc with new vendor contacts
- Run weekly metrics export (GH -> sheet) for team review Friday
